title: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
title_zh: 面向长期运行智能体的独立蒸馏记忆与检索策略组合
abstract_en: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.
abstract_zh: 长期运行的 Web 助手需要有效的记忆与检索机制，以利用过往用户交互中的信息。这两种能力可以由专用策略学习，但在不同环境中独立训练的策略能否在不进行联合优化的情况下有效协作，仍不明确。本文通过策略蒸馏研究组合迁移：利用前沿模型生成的动作轨迹，将记忆写入和序列检索策略分别蒸馏到 3B 模型中，再与固定的答案生成器组合，不做下游训练。在基于 LongMemEval 的基准上，蒸馏策略组合的准确率达到 73.1%，而已有强化学习（RL）专用策略的组合仅为 36.2%。在 PersonaMem-v2 上，蒸馏组合也优于所评估的 RL 策略组合。消融实验表明，改进单个策略能否提升整体表现，取决于它与其他策略的搭配。进一步进行任务适配后，通过 RL 在 LongMemEval 上达到 75.2%，通过监督蒸馏在 PersonaMem-v2 上达到 48.9%。结果表明，独立蒸馏是构建模块化多智能体系统的有效方法。作者公开了源代码，以及教师模型生成的记忆编辑与检索轨迹数据集。
key_points_zh: 将记忆写入和序列检索策略分别蒸馏到 3B 模型，再与固定答案生成器组合，无需下游训练。
在基于 LongMemEval 的基准上，蒸馏组合的准确率为 73.1%，已有 RL 策略组合为 36.2%；在 PersonaMem-v2 上也优于所评估的 RL 组合。
消融实验显示，单个策略的改进不一定转化为整体收益，策略间的兼容性是关键。
任务适配后，LongMemEval 准确率经 RL 提升至 75.2%，PersonaMem-v2 准确率经监督蒸馏达到 48.9%。

agent-memory.reason: 核心贡献是独立蒸馏记忆写入与逐步检索策略，无需联合训练即可组合使用。写入器将跨会话经验存入持久记忆库，供检索器在后续问答中使用。两个基准的组件消融揭示了搭配差异，并量化了准确率、存储与耗时的权衡。
